usedFor: Formilla keeps contacts for chat and email, and “Create Contact” or “Update Contact” keeps them current.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Update Contact” in Formilla
bestTemplate.why: A fresh message is a reason to refresh the contact, so details stay current.

watchOut: Anything that reaches someone outside the business waits in Needs you for your approval.
